subject.title: feat(plugin-runtime): support declarative tools and single-attempt completions

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `tools`, `toolCalls`, and `maxRetries` on the public plugin-runtime completion API, or should this capability remain behind a different owner boundary?
rationale: This is an additive external plugin API and establishes a long-lived compatibility contract; source review can verify forwarding but cannot choose the supported product boundary.

options.title: Approve the API direction
options.body: Keep the extension on `api.runtime.llm.complete`, subject to focused real-provider proof and compatibility coverage.

options.title: Narrow or relocate the capability
options.body: Define a different plugin/runtime seam if tool-loop control should not be part of the existing simple-completion API.

recommendation.title: Approve the API direction
recommendation.body: Keep the extension on `api.runtime.llm.complete`, subject to focused real-provider proof and compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent ownership of simple-completion runtime behavior makes this the strongest available routing signal.
